answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated value mixed with a future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse, unknown at registration; after the pulse, the verifier derives the task and checks the agent’s reveal. Whether labeled plume, ferrous, or nebula, a challenge therefore cannot be precomputed or reused from an offline cache. Fresh verification raises the cost of automated identity farms, though rate limits or admission controls are still needed to constrain Sybil creation.
